### Devotional: Ezekiel 16
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/2-samuel-8-9-2-corinthians-2-ezekiel-16-psalms-58-59/
Passage: Ezekiel 16
Points:
- Ezekiel employs shocking marital imagery to display the emotional horror and betrayal of spiritual apostasy.
- Jerusalem originated as an abandoned infant, owing her rescue, life, and royal beauty solely to God's gracious mercy.
- Instead of remaining faithful to her Lord, Jerusalem grew proud of her beauty and squandered God's gifts on idols.
- Unlike ordinary prostitutes who demand payment, Jerusalem brazenly paid and bribed foreign lovers to indulge in idolatry.
- True covenant keeping requires diligent remembrance of God's grace and solemn vows rather than self-centered wandering.
